provenance: Read-only query of the sibling validator data/mtx.db; MTX 17.2 local snapshot, not a claim about the latest upstream release.
query: select t.term_code,t.extended_name,t.deprecated,h.hierarchy_code,h.parent_code,h.reportable from terms t join term_hierarchies h using(term_code) where (h.parent_code='A07VF' and h.hierarchy_code='targcon') or (t.term_code='A0F1J' and h.hierarchy_code='report') or (t.term_code='A0CDD' and h.hierarchy_code='source') or (t.term_code='A01ZQ' and h.hierarchy_code='racsource') order by t.term_code
